claims.claim: BHP is extending its future-facing commodity exposure: FY26 included roughly 2 Mt of copper production for a second consecutive year, Jansen potash Stage 1 reached 84% completion with first production targeted for mid-2027, and management cites copper demand growth from about 34 Mtpa to more than 50 Mtpa by 2050.

risks.risk: Long-duration copper and potash theses remain exposed to commodity prices, permitting, capital intensity and project execution.

unknowns.unknown: Realized Jansen ramp economics and future copper project timing remain uncertain until execution milestones are delivered.

claims.claim: FY26 execution included record WAIO iron ore production and shipments, approximately 2 Mt of copper for a second year, stronger coal performance, and Jansen Stage 1 at 84% completion and on track for first production in mid-2027.

risks.risk: A contractor fatality at BMA underscores persistent operational safety risk despite strong production execution.

unknowns.unknown: Whether record volumes translate into sustained superior returns depends on commodity prices, costs and capital allocation.
